title: TrackFlow Telemetry Event Schemas
description: Single source of truth for TrackFlow telemetry events. Documented custom registry PLUS JSON Schema draft-07 validation for every event. Every event = standard Event Envelope + allowlisted properties. additionalProperties=false rejects any accidental data leakage at ingest.

userId.description: TinyDB user UUID, or 'anonymous' for pre-auth/public flows

requestId.description: Correlation id; X-Request-Id header joins FE-BE-logs-DB

route.description: normalized route template, no query string, no dynamic id values

warehouse.description: CONTEXT_6 normalized values; maps LA->los_angeles, ZGZ->zaragoza

client_id.description: stable slug derived from client_name (see plan Appendix A)

target_field.description: field they attempted to set, e.g. current_stock

field.description: failing field, e.g. tracking_number, reference, warehouse

note.const: Attempted email and password are NEVER captured.
Email address and reset token are NEVER captured.

message_hash.description: stable hash of message+stack, never raw text

candidate_id.description: internal candidate UUID; PII resolved via CRM with access control

note.const: Company name, contact person, corporate email and phone are NEVER captured in properties.

error_message_key.description: stable message id, never the typed value

note.const: Incident description (free text) is NEVER captured.
Supplier contact_email and notes are NEVER captured.
